claire.sales: Quick handoff for Lighthouse AI — closed Dedicated + Private (VPC), 12mo. Procurement flagged a potential mid-term discount review at month 9.
ben.cs: Thanks Claire. Can you post SSO contact, CIDRs, and any compliance notes? Who owns infra provisioning?
claire.sales: Tech contact infra@lighthouse.ai. Needs SAML2 + SCIM, customer KMS, audit logs. DPA attached in SF-9755. I created support ticket SF-9755 and added initial network ranges. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SF-9755
harper.enablement: I'll lead enablement and build the onboarding runbook. Proposed 3-week runway: week0 infra/provision, week1 SSO + SCIM, week2 prompts/evals + perf tuning. Will add acceptance criteria.
diego.support: I'll scope infra items. Need final SAML metadata, KMS ARN, and CIDR to size peering and routes. Please confirm expected token profile for sizing.
claire.sales: Uploaded CIDRs and preliminary SAML XML to SF-9755. Token pattern: bursty writes, expect short bursts up to 8k tokens/session initially.
maya.successops: I'll track account health and renewal signal. Suggest weekly check-ins for first 30d, then biweekly. Tagging renewal-risk: "procurement-review" + "discount-requested".
ben.cs: Action items (owners/due): 1) harper: publish runbook + acceptance checklist (48h) 2) diego: finalize SF-9755 scope & ETA (48h) 3) maya: draft renewal risk note & dashboard tile (72h) 4) claire: share final SAML metadata + SCIM test user (ASAP).
harper.enablement: Starting runbook now. Quick checklist snippet:
- Provision VPC peering & route tables
- Request KMS access & run encrypt/decrypt test
- Deploy private model image: redwood-dedicated-1
- Configure SAML + SCIM test user sync
- Perf smoke: 4k tokens across 30 concurrent sessions
diego.support: Pulled SF-9755, added infra checklist. ETA tentative 3 business days pending KMS ARN and SAML cert.
claire.sales: Pasted final SAML metadata and SCIM user into the ticket; security contact security@lighthouse.ai.
maya.successops: I'll create dashboard tiles for token usage, error rate, and eval quality. Also drafting renewal cadence and escalation triggers.
onboard-bot: onboarding-playbook v2 applied to Lighthouse workspace.
ben.cs: I'll schedule kickoff for next Wednesday and post a calendar invite. Keep updates here; ping me for blockers. :calendar:
